description: Defines callback classes and interfaces for cookie store operations, including result handling and thread assertions, used in testing cookie-related functionalities.

classes.name: CookieCallback
classes.description: Base class for cookie operation callbacks, managing thread assertions and synchronization.

classes.name: ResultSavingCookieCallback
classes.description: Template class for callbacks that save results of cookie operations.

classes.name: NoResultCookieCallback
classes.description: Callback class for cookie operations that do not return a result.

classes.name: GetCookieListCallback
classes.description: Callback class for retrieving a list of cookies and associated access results.

classes.name: GetAllCookiesCallback
classes.description: Callback class for retrieving all cookies.

classes.name: GetAllCookiesWithAccessSemanticsCallback
classes.description: Callback class for retrieving all cookies with access semantics information.

methods.name: WaitUntilDone
methods.description: Waits until the callback has been invoked.

methods.name: was_run
methods.description: Checks if the callback was executed.

methods.name: CallbackEpilogue
methods.description: Performs thread validation and signals completion.

methods.name: MakeCallback
methods.description: Creates a bound callback to invoke the Run method.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the callback logic with provided results.
